description: Removes the marks an AI generator leaves in the audio (narrow tones above 15 kHz, level jumps at block seams, fixed spectral peaks), while loudness and tone are kept. Cleanup does not conceal that a track is AI-made: disclose AI use wherever a platform asks. One run a day is free; further runs use 1 credit each. Returns a job id to poll with get_job.

audio_url.description: Track address as a public https link: a direct file (wav, mp3, flac, m4a) or a sharing link, which the server opens for you.

out_format.description: Container and encoding of the rendered file.

sensitivity.description: Strength from 0 to 1; leave it unset to use the server default.

name: clean_ai_trace
title: Clean AI generator artifacts
